rows.note: Use 改 as the all-purpose verb for deliberately changing a form, structure, plan, or arrangement.

example.english: We need to alter the plan.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 goi2 go3 gai3 waak6

rows.note: Use 變 when something becomes different, especially without emphasizing who deliberately changed it.

example.english: The situation can alter very quickly.
example.jyutping: go3 cing4 fong3 ho2 ji5 bin3 dak1 hou2 faai3

rows.note: Use 改衫 specifically when a tailor alters clothing so that it fits.

example.english: I need to take these trousers to a tailor to alter them so they fit.
example.traditional: 呢條褲要拎去改衫，先至啱身。
example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 fu3 jiu3 ling1 heoi3 goi2 saam1 sin1 zi3 ngaam1 san1
